title: HINT v0.3 recommendation and effect records

Simulation.description: L4 is not a simulation level; empirical results are Effect records.

Step.description: A declarative step. It names entities and an action; it never carries a command or code.

findings.description: Effort findings in heuristic priority order (v0.2).

Effect.description: An effect measured on comparable real tasks before and after a change (L4). Never a forecast.

Finding.description: An evidence-backed effort finding (v0.2): observed quantities, scope, references, coverage, cause hypotheses and a checkable next step. Causes are hypotheses; the array order is a heuristic priority, not a calibrated ranking.

evidence_state.description: limited: the facts hold, but coverage or the number of tasks is too low to separate the causes.

Abstention.description: A problem class that the server did not diagnose, and why (v0.2).

Decision.description: The minimum sufficient intervention for a finding (v0.2): observed differences of eval variant pairs that are bound to the finding's objectives, per alternative, with units, coverage and the pair reference (project_comparisons). Without a binding the alternatives are unbound and the choice is COLLECT_MORE_EVIDENCE. Incomplete resource coverage is not used for a choice. No net value, horizon or break-even: the cost model (07B) is unavailable.

ContextFeedback.description: Feedback on one effective context policy identity (v0.2): counters derived from context measurements and a comparison of whole task windows against a matched cohort (same agent source, same edited components, context observed and no delivery). Proposals only; heuristic.

ProjectComparison.description: A project-level eval variant comparison (v0.2), not bound to a finding: observed differences with coverage and the provenance of the compared eval versions.

ForecastBasis.description: How a plan's forecast is to be read (v0.2): the scalar resource objective, the stated horizon, the model-conditional probability of a positive net value and the net interval over that horizon, the decision threshold and its provenance, the basis of the one-time cost, the kind of evidence and every qualification of the forecast. A forecast is never a measurement.

p_net_gain_positive.description: Model-conditional P(net value over the horizon > 0); null when unknown.

net_gain_interval.description: Net value over the horizon in the objective unit (total, not per task); negative values are valid; null when unknown.

cost_basis.description: observed_comparable_work: an estimate from observed comparable refactoring work, not a measured cost of this change; assumption_scenario: a stated scenario; null: unknown.

EffectBasis.description: Draft v0.2, optional: which effect distribution supplies the forecast economics. Absent: the legacy model-projection reading. model_projection: the model's paired per-task token delta over the sampled task mix, with a model-conditional interval (not a prediction for one task). observed_objective_clustered: an observed controlled comparison, intervention minus baseline tokens per task over objective clusters, with the uncertainty of its mean (not a validated production effect of a change). Wire checks validate the labels, the fields and their internal arithmetic only; whether the opaque records belong to the population and support the summary is checked by the producer, not by this document.

effect.description: The observed per-task effect: the mean delta and its interval, in the forecast objective unit. Separate from the model's model_tokens prediction.

objectives.description: Number of objective clusters of the observed comparison.

record_refs.description: Opaque references to the producer records of the observed comparison.

population_ref.description: Opaque reference to the scoped population of the observed comparison.

evidence_policy.description: The public interpretation of an observed controlled comparison; it identifies the reading, not proof of eligibility.

EffortDelta.description: An observed token difference per attempt with its interval, coverage (objectives with known counters, all objectives) and the provenance of its counters (draft v0.2).

counter_semantics.description: The token counters behind the difference. harbor-0.23.0+opencode:n-tokens-root-v1: Harbor 0.23.0 counters of an OpenCode run (root session only; input includes cache reads; output excludes reasoning; a missing step usage reads as 0). hint-task-tokens-v1: non-cached input plus generated output including reasoning, over the whole task. openai-compat-provider-totals-v1: the provider-reported prompt and completion totals of the observed requests of an isolated run with a complete, enforced model ledger (cache and reasoning semantics unknown); descriptive only, never task effort. Absent means unknown.

scope.description: The part of the task's model work the counters cover. Only full_task with hint-task-tokens-v1 supports an effort-based decision; with openai-compat-provider-totals-v1, full_task means the observed request population of an isolated run, not task effort. Absent means unknown.
